name: Explain this in plain language
description: Paste an excerpt and the agent rewrites it for a non-expert.
prompt:
Explain the following in plain language for a non-expert audience. Keep the structure, define jargon, and finish with three takeaways.

[Paste excerpt here]

name: Summarize as bullet points
description: Turn a long document into a short bulleted summary.
prompt:
Summarize the following as bullet points. Lead with the headline, then 5–8 supporting bullets covering the main facts, decisions, and open questions.

[Paste document here]

name: Turn notes into a checklist
description: Convert loose notes into an action checklist with owners.
prompt:
Convert the following notes into a checklist. Each item is a single action with an owner and a deadline if one is implied.

[Paste notes here]
